versions.changelog:
Alibaba Cloud Model Studio entry skill – initial release.

- Provides unified routing for Model Studio requests to the appropriate local skill based on user intent (text, code, image, video, audio, search, multimodal).
- Includes a comprehensive routing table mapping common AI tasks to existing sub-skills.
- Offers usage notes, troubleshooting tips, and standard polling templates for async tasks.
- Documents recommended clarifying questions for ambiguous requests.
- Validation steps and output handling conventions are specified for reproducibility.
